# 6UMMY

> DJ, collector and curator based in Montevideo, Uruguay. Techno, House, and
> Rares. Livestreams, gigs, and vinyl since 2004. Personal site: one page,
> bilingual (English / Spanish), no tracking and no cookies. Live data comes
> from a Cloudflare Worker and everything degrades to readable text if that
> Worker is unreachable.

Identity: 6UMMY, also written 6ummy. Based in Montevideo, Uruguay (UTC-3),
active since 2004. Formats: vinyl and digital. Styles: techno, house, rares.
Contact: sync@6ummy.xyz.

The page is a single document with seven sections — Stream (live Twitch status
and player), Dates (upcoming gigs, falling back to recent past dates), Sets
(recorded SoundCloud sessions), Portfolio (a curated YouTube playlist), Crate
(the record collection, newest first, from Discogs), Elsewhere (profiles and
projects), and Bookings & contact. Stream, Dates, Portfolio and Crate are filled
in by the Worker at page load; the rest is in the HTML.

## Site

- [6ummy.xyz](https://6ummy.xyz/): the canonical page, and the whole site — everything below is a profile hosted elsewhere.

## Profiles

- [Twitch](https://www.twitch.tv/6ummy): livestreams; the Stream section on the site reflects this channel's live status.
- [SoundCloud](https://soundcloud.com/6ummy): recorded vinyl sets, including the Décimo Piso and mnml snds series.
- [Discogs](https://www.discogs.com/user/6ummy): the record collection the Crate section is drawn from.
- [X](https://x.com/6ummy): posts and announcements.
- [Décimo Piso on YouTube](https://www.youtube.com/@10mopiso): video series.
- [Domingo Feliz on YouTube](https://www.youtube.com/@domingo_feliz): video series, also written DMF.

## Projects

- [Night Watcher](https://nightwatcher.life): separate project, not a 6UMMY release channel.
- [Techno Punks](https://discord.gg/CfmfMxDZv5): Discord community.
- [VINILOS](https://x.com/i/communities/1493258083975385088): X community about records.

## Optional

- [objkt](https://objkt.com/@6ummy): collectibles.
